transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you, too. 

Um, I'm here because... well, I work as a bookkeeping clerk, and I just can't stop going back over the same spreadsheets and calculations again and again. I end up staying at work for hours after everyone else leaves, even when I've already checked everything multiple times. It's just that if I don't check it one more time, I feel like... like something really bad will happen, and it'll be my fault.
When you are checking your work, do you feel like you have to do it even though you know, deep down, that the work is likely already correct?

Yeah, exactly. Um, even after I know the numbers match perfectly, this thought just keeps jumping into my head. I'll start thinking that I missed one hidden mistake somewhere in the payroll or the taxes, and that somebody's check won't go through, or the firm is going to get in trouble. 

I really try to push the thought away, because like you said, I know it's probably correct, but... it just comes right back. It's honestly like I can't trust my own eyes.
Outside of your work, do you find yourself needing to perform any other repetitive actions or rituals, like washing your hands or arranging items in a specific way, to feel at ease?

No, not really. Um, I don't wash my hands more than normal or anything like that. And I don't really care about how things are arranged at home. It's pretty much just the checking at work with the numbers and spreadsheets. That's the only thing that really gets me stuck like that.
Looking back at your life, have you ever experienced other repetitive behaviors or rituals, such as excessive cleaning or counting, even if they aren't happening right now?

No, I don't think so. Um, looking back, I never really had issues with cleaning or counting things when I was younger, or anything like that. It's really just been this checking thing with the spreadsheets at my job. I honestly can't think of anything else like that from my past.
